pairs: Alleluja.
Alleluia.
Confitemini Domino,
Confess to the Lord,
quoniam bonus,
for he is good,
quoniam in sæculum misericordia ejus.
for his mercy is with every generation.
Quis loquetur potentias Domini;
Who will declare the powers of the Lord?
auditas faciet omnes laudes ejus?
Who make a hearing for all his praises?
Beati qui custodiunt judicium,
Blessed are those who keep judgment
et faciunt justitiam in omni tempore.
and who do justice at all times.
Memento nostri,
Remember us,
Domine,
O Lord,
in beneplacito populi tui;
with good will for your people.
visita nos in salutari tuo:
Visit us with your salvation,
ad videndum in bonitate electorum tuorum;
so that we may see the goodness of your elect,
ad lætandum in lætitia gentis tuæ:
so that we may rejoice in the joy of your nation,
ut lauderis cum hæreditate tua.
so that you may be praised along with your inheritance.
Peccavimus cum patribus nostris:
We have sinned, as have our fathers.
injuste egimus;
We have acted unjustly;
iniquitatem fecimus.
we have wrought iniquity.
Patres nostri in Ægypto non intellexerunt mirabilia tua;
Our fathers did not understand your miracles in Egypt.
non fuerunt memores multitudinis misericordiæ tuæ.
They did not remember the multitude of your mercies.
Et irritaverunt ascendentes in mare,
And they provoked you, while going up to the sea,
mare Rubrum;
even the Red Sea.
et salvavit eos propter nomen suum,
And he saved them for the sake of his name,
ut notam faceret potentiam suam.
so that he might make known his power.
Et increpuit mare Rubrum et exsiccatum est,
And he rebuked the Red Sea, and it dried up.
et deduxit eos in abyssis sicut in deserto.
And he led them into the abyss, as if into a desert.
Et salvavit eos de manu odientium,
And he saved them from the hand of those who hated them.
et redemit eos de manu inimici.
And he redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
Et operuit aqua tribulantes eos;
And the water covered those who troubled them.
unus ex eis non remansit.
Not one of them remained.
Et crediderunt verbis ejus,
And they believed his words,
et laudaverunt laudem ejus.
and they sang his praises.
Cito fecerunt;
As soon as they had finished,
obliti sunt operum ejus:
they forgot his works,
et non sustinuerunt consilium ejus.
and they would not endure his counsel.
Et concupierunt concupiscentiam in deserto,
And they coveted their desire in the desert,
et tentaverunt Deum in inaquoso.
and they tempted God in a waterless place.
Et dedit eis petitionem ipsorum,
And he granted to them their request,
et misit saturitatem in animas eorum.
and he sent abundance into their souls.
Et irritaverunt Moysen in castris;
And they provoked Moses in the camp,
Aaron,
and Aaron,
sanctum Domini.
the holy one of the Lord.
Aperta est terra,
The earth opened
et deglutivit Dathan,
and swallowed Dathan,
et operuit super congregationem Abiron.
and it covered the congregation of Abiram.
Et exarsit ignis in synagoga eorum:
And a fire broke out in their congregation.
flamma combussit peccatores.
A flame burned up the sinners.
Et fecerunt vitulum in Horeb,
And they fashioned a calf at Horeb,
et adoraverunt sculptile.
and they adored a graven image.
Et mutaverunt gloriam suam in similitudinem vituli comedentis fœnum.
And they exchanged their glory for the likeness of a calf that eats hay.
Obliti sunt Deum qui salvavit eos;
They forgot God, who saved them,
qui fecit magnalia in Ægypto,
who did great things in Egypt:
mirabilia in terra Cham,
miracles in the land of Ham,
terribilia in mari Rubro.
terrible things at the Red Sea.
Et dixit ut disperderet eos,
And he said that he would destroy them,
si non Moyses,
yet Moses,
electus ejus,
his elect,
stetisset in confractione in conspectu ejus,
stood firm before him in the breach,
ut averteret iram ejus,
in order to avert his wrath,
ne disperderet eos.
lest he destroy them.
Et pro nihilo habuerunt terram desiderabilem;
And they held the desirable land to be nothing.
non crediderunt verbo ejus.
They did not trust in his word.
Et murmuraverunt in tabernaculis suis;
And they murmured in their tabernacles.
non exaudierunt vocem Domini.
They did not heed the voice of the Lord.
Et elevavit manum suam super eos ut prosterneret eos in deserto:
And he lifted up his hand over them, in order to prostrate them in the desert,
et ut dejiceret semen eorum in nationibus,
and in order to cast their offspring among the nations,
et dispergeret eos in regionibus.
and to scatter them among the regions.
Et initiati sunt Beelphegor,
And they were initiated into Baal of Peor,
et comederunt sacrificia mortuorum.
and they ate the sacrifices of the dead.
Et irritaverunt eum in adinventionibus suis,
And they provoked him with their inventions,
et multiplicata est in eis ruina.
and ruination was multiplied in them.
Et stetit Phinees,
Then Phinehas stood up
et placavit,
and placated him:
et cessavit quassatio.
and so the violent disturbance ceased.
Et reputatum est ei in justitiam,
And it was reputed to him unto justice,
in generationem
from generation to generation,
et generationem usque in sempiternum.
even forever.
Et irritaverunt eum ad aquas contradictionis,
And they provoked him at the Waters of Contradiction,
et vexatus est Moyses propter eos:
and Moses was afflicted because of them,
quia exacerbaverunt spiritum ejus,
for they exasperated his spirit.
et distinxit in labiis suis.
And so he divided them with his lips.
Non disperdiderunt gentes quas dixit Dominus illis:
They did not destroy the nations, about which the Lord had spoken to them.
et commisti sunt inter gentes,
And they were mixed among the Gentiles.
et didicerunt opera eorum;
And they learned their works,
et servierunt sculptilibus eorum,
and they served their graven images,
et factum est illis in scandalum.
and it became a scandal to them.
Et immolaverunt filios suos et filias suas dæmoniis.
And they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.
Et effuderunt sanguinem innocentem,
And they shed innocent blood:
sanguinem filiorum suorum et filiarum suarum,
the blood of their sons and of their daughters,
quas sacrificaverunt sculptilibus Chanaan.
which they sacrificed to the graven images of Canaan.
Et infecta est terra in sanguinibus,
And the land was infected with bloodshed,
et contaminata est in operibus eorum:
and was contaminated with their works.
et fornicati sunt in adinventionibus suis.
And they fornicated according to their own inventions.
Et iratus est furore Dominus in populum suum,
And the Lord became furiously angry with his people,
et abominatus est hæreditatem suam.
and he abhorred his inheritance.
Et tradidit eos in manus gentium;
And he delivered them into the hands of the nations.
et dominati sunt eorum qui oderunt eos.
And those who hated them became rulers over them.
Et tribulaverunt eos inimici eorum,
And their enemies afflicted them,
et humiliati sunt sub manibus eorum;
and they were humbled under their hands.
sæpe liberavit eos.
Many times, he delivered them.
Ipsi autem exacerbaverunt eum in consilio suo,
Yet they provoked him with their counsel,
et humiliati sunt in iniquitatibus suis.
and they were brought low by their iniquities.
Et vidit cum tribularentur,
And he saw that they were in tribulation,
et audivit orationem eorum.
and he heard their prayer.
Et memor fuit testamenti sui,
And he was mindful of his covenant,
et pœnituit eum secundum multitudinem misericordiæ suæ:
and he repented according to the multitude of his mercies.
et dedit eos in misericordias,
And he provided for them with mercies,
in conspectu omnium qui ceperant eos.
in the sight of all those who had seized them.
Salvos nos fac,
Save us,
Domine Deus noster,
O Lord our God,
et congrega nos de nationibus:
and gather us from the nations,
ut confiteamur nomini sancto tuo,
so that we may confess your holy name
et gloriemur in laude tua.
and glory in your praise.
Benedictus Dominus Deus Israël,
Blessed is the Lord God of Israel,
a sæculo
from ages past,
et usque in sæculum;
even to all ages.
et dicet omnis populus:
And let all the people say:
Fiat,
Amen.
fiat.
Amen.
